heading: Durability Testing FAQ
subtitle: Laboratory abrasion tests, tensile strength, and color fastness ratings.

questions.question: What Martindale rub count durability score was achieved?
questions.answer: Exceeds 50,000 Martindale rubs, classifying it for severe commercial-grade abrasion resistance.

questions.question: What color fastness rating to light and washing was certified?
questions.answer: Certified Grade 4-5 on ISO gray scale, guaranteeing zero color fading under direct sunlight or washing.

questions.question: How does the fabric perform under tear strength testing?
questions.answer: Tensile strength certified to 450N warp and 400N weft resistance against tearing.

questions.question: Is pilling resistance verified under ISO standards?
questions.answer: Achieves Grade 4 ISO 12945-2 anti-pilling rating, resisting surface fuzzing during daily wear.
